# Plot

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy |> 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"
  ))

# count(candy, type)
```

## Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "heart",
  color = "warning",
  value = nrow(candy)
)
```

```{r}
# #| content: valuebox
# #| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"
# 
# list(
#   icon = "heart",
#   color = "warning",
#   value = sum(candy$type == "fruity")
# )


```

```{r}

bars_vs_bags <- candy |> 
  mutate(preference = case_when(
    bar & pluribus ~ "both",
    bar ~ "bars",
    pluribus ~ "bags of candy pieces",
    .default = "other"
  ))

# count(bars_vs_bags, preference)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Bags of Pieces of Candy"

list(
  icon = "bag-heart",
  color = "danger",
  value = sum(bars_vs_bags$preference == "bags of candy pieces")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Bars"

list(
  icon = "aspect-ratio",
  color = "success",
  value = sum(bars_vs_bags$preference == "bars")
)

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Other"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "info",
  value = sum(bars_vs_bags$preference == "other")
)

```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: bars vs bags of candy

bars_vs_bags_candy <- ggplot(data = bars_vs_bags, aes(x = preference, fill = preference)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Candy Preference", y = "Number of Responses", title = "Bars vs Bags of Candy")

ggplotly(bars_vs_bags_candy, tooltip = c("x","count"))
```

# Data Table

```{r}
bars_vs_bags <- bars_vs_bags |> 
  select(competitorname, bar, pluribus, preference)

knitr::kable(bars_vs_bags) 
  
count(bars_vs_bags, preference)
```
